title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding the CCNY campus in Hamilton Heights, featuring historic landmarks, student-frequented cafes, and cultural hubs.

cards.title: Cafe One on Amsterdam
cards.subtitle: Amsterdam Avenue & West 140th Street
cards.notes: Visit this corner cafe for standard student fare like paninis and muffins; it is a convenient stop located directly across from the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A convenient corner cafe on Amsterdam Avenue popular with students for quick lunches and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe One is located at 1619 Amsterdam Avenue at the corner of 140th Street and is a convenient place for students to grab lunch or dessert.
cards.source_title: Cafe One – New York, NY - Harlem One Stop
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 AM on weekdays and 8:00 AM on weekends.

cards.title: The Grange on Convent
cards.subtitle: Convent Avenue & West 141st Street
cards.notes: Tour the relocated home of Alexander Hamilton; the historic mansion sits at the northern edge of St. Nicholas Park near the campus.
cards.short_summary: The historic home of Alexander Hamilton, now a National Memorial located in St. Nicholas Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Grange is located at 414 West 141st Street and is managed by the National Park Service.
cards.source_title: Hamilton Grange National Memorial (U.S. National Park Service)
cards.access_notes: The grounds are open daily; check the NPS website for interior tour schedules.

cards.title: Sugar Hill Cafe Hub
cards.subtitle: West 145th Street & St. Nicholas Avenue
cards.notes: Study with a Plowshares coffee at this rustic-chic spot; it is a favorite for local students seeking a quiet atmosphere near the 145th Street station.
cards.short_summary: A popular student study spot and cafe located near the 145th Street subway station.
cards.evidence_claim: Sugar Hill Cafe is located at 410 W 145th St and is known as a favorite place for students to study and read.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 AM on weekdays and 9:00 AM on weekends.

cards.title: St. Nicholas Park Slopes
cards.subtitle: St. Nicholas Terrace & West 135th Street
cards.notes: Walk the steep paths of this 28-acre park that borders the eastern edge of the campus, offering green space and city views.
cards.short_summary: A large public park bordering the CCNY campus, featuring historic sites and recreational areas.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park borders the City College campus on the east and runs from 128th to 141st Streets.
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The Broadway Corridor
cards.subtitle: Broadway & West 137th Street
cards.notes: Access the campus via the 1 train at this major transit hub; the surrounding block features essential delis and grocery stores for commuters.
cards.short_summary: The primary subway access point for CCNY, surrounded by local commercial services.
cards.evidence_claim: The 137 St-City College station on Broadway serves as a primary transit point for the college.

cards.title: The Gatehouse on 135th
cards.subtitle: West 135th Street & Convent Avenue
cards.notes: Attend a performance at this restored 19th-century pump house; it serves as a major cultural venue for Harlem's performing arts.
cards.short_summary: A historic landmark and performing arts venue located at the southern end of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Harlem Stage is located in the Gatehouse at 150 Convent Avenue at West 135th Street.
cards.access_notes: Check the official website for performance schedules and box office hours.

cards.title: Tsion Cafe Culture
cards.subtitle: St. Nicholas Avenue & West 141st Street
cards.notes: Experience Ethiopian and Middle Eastern cuisine at this Sugar Hill landmark; it often hosts live music and community art events.
cards.short_summary: A cultural destination in Sugar Hill offering Ethiopian cuisine and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Tsion Cafe is located at 763 St. Nicholas Ave and specializes in Ethiopian and Middle Eastern cuisine.
cards.source_title: Tsion Cafe: New York City Restaurant, Harlem - NYC Tourism
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner on weekdays and brunch on weekends.

cards.title: Chipped Cup on Hamilton
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Place & West 143rd Street
cards.notes: Grab a latte at this basement-level coffee shop known for its cozy garden seating and student-friendly work environment.
cards.short_summary: A popular neighborhood coffee shop with a hidden garden, located just north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chipped Cup is located at 3610 Broadway (near Hamilton Place) and is a recommended cafe for studying in the area.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

cards.title: Home Sweet Harlem Bistro
cards.subtitle: Amsterdam Avenue & West 135th Street
cards.notes: Enjoy American comfort food at this plant-filled bistro; it offers free Wi-Fi and is a popular spot for remote work and weekend brunch.
cards.short_summary: A cozy bistro on Amsterdam Avenue known for comfort food and a welcoming study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Home Sweet Harlem is located at 1528 Amsterdam Ave and offers free wifi for customers to do homework or work remotely.
cards.source_title: Home Sweet Harlem: Must-Try Restaurant in Harlem, NY
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check website for specific brunch and dinner hours.

cards.title: Jackie Robinson Park Edge
cards.subtitle: West 145th Street & Edgecombe Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the recreation center or pool at this historic park; it serves as a major community hub just a few blocks north of the college.
cards.short_summary: A historic 12-acre park featuring a large pool and recreation center near the Hamilton Heights district.
cards.evidence_claim: Jackie Robinson Park is located at West 145th Street and Edgecombe Avenue, near the City College campus.
cards.access_notes: Park open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM; pool hours vary seasonally.
